text: Planning is still not fleshed out properly: the verifier of 20261016-035342-px6g found the refusal gate rarely fires because every job gets a default rung and a request's first line counts as acceptance. Make the plan fields come from an actual planning pass that reads each open item against the brief, the records and the code, so goal, rung, acceptance, open questions, dependencies and touched paths are real, flag items that are underspecified instead of defaulting them, and let me see the coordinated plan.
